**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeReorderEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeReorderEvent.java)

The event of `beforeReorder`, which can refuse a new place of the dragged child.

## Description

A refused move keeps the child at its place; the drag goes on.

## Learn more

- [Reorderable lists](/use/learn/interactivity/reorderable-lists/#react-to-a-new-order)
